fields.climate: temperate; cool summers; cold, cloudy, humid winters
fields.terrain: rugged mountains in the central and northern part and lowlands in the south
fields.resources: lignite, small amounts of iron ore, copper and manganese ore; salt; arable land
fields.farm: wheat, sugar beets, maize, milk, barley, rapeseed, sunflower seeds, potatoes, soybeans, pork
fields.exports: cars, vehicle parts/accessories, video displays, broadcasting equipment, refined petroleum
fields.industries: automobiles; metal and metal products; electricity, gas, coke, oil, nuclear fuel; chemicals, synthetic fibers, wood and paper products; machinery; earthenware and ceramics; textiles…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 55.8%, Evangelical Church of the Augsburg Confession 5.3%, Greek Catholic 4%, Reformed Christian 1.6%, other 3%, none 23.8%, unspecified 6.5%

independence.event: Czechoslovakia split into the Czech Republic and Slovakia

fields.legal: civil law system based on Austro-Hungarian codes
fields.military: minimum age is 18 for voluntary service for men and women; citizens 18-65 can volunteer for the military reserves
